subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Device Lab vs Cloud Testing
description: A quick win: understand Device Lab vs Cloud Testing.

hook.text: A company buys 50 phones for testing. Within a year, half are outdated. The budget for new devices is gone.

buildup.text: A physical device lab provides real hardware but requires maintenance, space, and constant refreshing.

discovery.text: Cloud device farms offer hundreds of real devices on-demand, eliminating hardware maintenance costs.

twist.text: Cloud devices lack physical access: you can't test NFC, Bluetooth pairing, or true camera behavior remotely.

climax.text: A hybrid approach uses cloud for broad coverage and a small physical lab for hardware-specific tests.

punchline.text: Cloud for scale. Lab for hardware. Both for confidence.

quiz.question: What is a limitation of cloud device testing?
options: Can't test physical hardware features like NFC or Bluetooth
